rule.statement: A party can appeal to set aside an interlocutory decree on the ground that they could not appear in court due to illness.
rule.supporting_quote: After an inquiry the learned District Judge, by his order dated 29.5.2009 dismissed the application of the 12A Defendant-Appellant.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 48(4) of the Partition Law No 21 of 1997
